text:
```yaml
name: Sync PX4 Metadata
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 6 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  sync-metadata:
    if: github.repository_owner == 'mavlink'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download airframes.xml
        run: |
          mkdir -p src/AutoPilotPlugins/PX4/
          curl -sSL https://artifacts.px4.io/Firmware/_general/airframes.xml -o src/AutoPilotPlugins/PX4/AirframeFactMetaData.xml

      - name: Download parameters.xml
        run: |
          mkdir -p src/FirmwarePlugin/PX4/
          curl -sSL https://artifacts.px4.io/Firmware/_general/parameters.xml -o src/FirmwarePlugin/PX4/PX4ParameterFactMetaData.xml

      - name: Create Pull Request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v8
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: update PX4 metadata"
          title: "chore: update PX4 metadata"
          body: "Daily update of PX4 airframe and parameter metadata from artifacts.px4.io"
          branch: "px4-metadata-update"
          base: "main"
          add-paths: |
            src/AutoPilotPlugins/PX4/AirframeFactMetaData.xml
            src/FirmwarePlugin/PX4/PX4ParameterFactMetaData.xml
```
